learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to explain the differences between ideal and real gases, and calculate the properties of real gases.
They will understand and be able to apply the laws of thermodynamics.
They will grasp physical equilibrium and phase diagrams, and be able to interpret phase diagrams.
They will understand the differences between ideal and real solutions.
They will grasp the role of thermodynamics and kinetics in chemical equilibrium.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Physical Chemistry, Basic Concepts
The First Law of Thermodynamics: Work and Energy
The First Law of Thermodynamics: Internal Energy and Enthalpy
The First Law of Thermodynamics: Thermochemistry
The Second Law of Thermodynamics: Entropy
The Second Law of Thermodynamics: Third law, Helmholtz and Gibbs energies
Combining the First and Second Laws: Maxwell equations, Gibbs energy
Physical Transitions of Pure Substances - Simple Mixtures: Thermodynamic Definition of Mixtures, Properties of Solutions
Simple Mixtures: Phase diagrams for two-component systems
